summary: Resubmitted the formal check as a repair (repair_of b8570f63f6004bfd8e19bc4f762d903a) of the operation the controller rejected only because the agent final response was not parseable; the draft itself is unchanged and still preflight-valid. The check targets unit-claim-config-publish-requires-durable-append for obligation claim-config-publish-requires-durable-append, with plan_path plan.json and harness_path probe_config_publish_test.go. The plan admits one leader operation (prerequisite alias adm = assurance_leader_established plus alias act = assurance_config_change_attempt) and inspects the result event assurance_config_published for the same operation using identity field node; its one event_assertion property (checker checker-config-publish-durable) triggers on published_ahead_of_durable true and asserts entry_durable true, meaning a configuration installed as configurations.latest must have its entry in the durable log. Harness legality and the monitor grounding cite the accepted materials for appendConfigurationEntry, dispatchLogs and the configurations doc, and all binding_ids reference the unit bindings. The harness bootstraps one voter over an InmemStore whose StoreLogs can be failed on demand at the real LogStore boundary, waits for leadership, emits the two prerequisites, runs AddVoter while exactly one StoreLogs call fails, then reports whether the log index assigned to that change is present in the store; a local verification run emitted the three monitor events with published_ahead_of_durable true and entry_durable false, so the assertion should produce a violating witness. Recorded uncertainties: only one failing StoreLogs timing is exercised, and the fault is explicitly supplied by the harness rather than produced by real producers. plan.harness.source and files are intentionally omitted so the controller fixes the harness bytes, and checker correspondence will still need a separate review before the violation can be marked confirmed. Preflight validation returned valid true. No source, evidence, credential or dependency files were modified; the draft contains submission.json, plan.json and probe_config_publish_test.go.
